title: Made my dream come true (Gameboy Advance)
author: SaraSolGames
selftext:
Game name: Babale from Vlora  
Link: [https://sarasol.itch.io/babale-from-vlora](https://sarasol.itch.io/babale-from-vlora)  
Game trailer: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ESo\_I32IpJA](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ESo_I32IpJA)

The story is meant to be cheezy, but it's jokes that I like.  
The combat is made with things that I have enjoyed from other games too, like parry and perfect dodge.  
The scenes are with images from real places from my hometown, handpicked by me.  
The 10 bosses have their own personality and fit well with the story.  
I have added also 2 mini-games, just for fun.

I loved working on it. It has been a fun couple of months.  
I am not rich. Obviously I can't pay a developer or an artist, but I am grateful that with the help of AI I could build something I really enjoy playing.  
Cheers!
